Opt in to OCR elements to get each word's text, bounding box and confidence

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';
import 'package:xberg/src/xberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final input = await createExtractInputFromJson(json: '{"kind":"uri","mime_type":"image/png","uri":"https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png"}');
    final config = await createExtractionConfigFromJson(json: '{"force_ocr":true,"ocr":{"backend":"tesseract","element_config":{"include_elements":true,"min_level":"word"},"enabled":true,"language":["eng"]}}');
    final result = await XbergBridge.extract(input, config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].ocrElements);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
